nodes.label: Goal100 gap review and frozen checkpoint evaluation — 2026-11-14
nodes.status: Allocated 24-slot frozen pilot completed; retain B0 reference and defer further long training

nodes.label: Goal100 24-slot frozen pilot
nodes.summary: Four arms × three development layouts × two fresh-launch blocks consumed 24/24 slots. Twenty-three had valid measurement; 18 succeeded. One robot and one training seed 11; deterministic checkpoints, no exploration/optimizer/replay updates. Caps: 250 decisions/slot, 6000 total, 45 minutes; no automatic replacement. Gates: 40 mm cross-track, 50 mm/15° goal, continuous quiet 2 s, deadline 25 s and full clearance. Validation/test layouts unused.
nodes.rationale: Equal reset-seed metadata is not identical Gazebo physical state or an independent training seed. Data-invalid slots remain unknown and allocated; these engineering gates do not establish factory requirements.

nodes.label: Frozen pilot B0 reference
nodes.summary: Same estimator, follower and velocity PI as learned arms with residual zero. Five successes from six valid/attempted slots: clear 2/2, early step 1/2, late step 2/2.
nodes.rationale: B0 does not represent every tuned classical speed profile or governor.

nodes.label: Frozen pilot TD3 10k prelearning checkpoint
nodes.summary: Checkpoint has zero optimizer updates. Five successes from six valid/attempted slots: clear 2/2, early 2/2, late 1/2.
nodes.rationale: The checkpoint label does not imply an optimized actor.

nodes.label: Frozen pilot TD3 15k checkpoint
nodes.summary: Checkpoint has 4,999 critic updates. Four successes from six valid/attempted slots: clear 2/2, early 1/2, late 1/2.

nodes.label: Frozen pilot TD3 20k checkpoint
nodes.summary: Checkpoint has 10,000 critic updates. Four successes and one task failure among five valid rollouts, plus one startup unknown among six allocated slots. Layout success/valid/attempted: clear 2/2/2, early 1/2/2, late 1/1/2. Allocated-slot pass bound is 4–5 of six.
nodes.rationale: Do not present missing measurement as policy failure or report an 80% rate as complete coverage. No replacement of slot 16 after seeing results.

nodes.label: Episode 57 gap traced into PI control diagnostics
nodes.status: Original training raw QC remains failed
nodes.summary: Retained episode-57 raw matches its original manifest. At 2.616 s PI diagnostics report one update with raw dt sum/max 54 ms against configured 2 ms. Two independent joint recorders match all 51 payloads in the reviewed window with at most 2 ms source gap. World control had ACK, expected iterations and no retry/overstep; reference was zero.
nodes.rationale: The long interval exists in PI-emitted diagnostics, not merely a missing Python recorder row. Executor scheduling versus clock delivery remains unresolved; configured 500 Hz does not prove 2 ms execution, and zero-reference warmup does not establish 54 ms of erroneous body motion.

nodes.label: Frozen pilot stall, goal-stop, path and startup failures
nodes.summary: Slots 8/10k, 11/B0 and 20/15k stalled with wheel actual near zero, targets about 3 rad/s and simulated effort 1.3–1.5 Nm below 4 Nm cap. Slot 15/15k cleared the step but timed out: physical goal error 58.8 mm while estimated_goal_stop_latched emitted zero. Slot 19/20k exceeded the path gate at approximately 46.35 mm. Slot 16/20k had 117 ms wheel source age before task epoch and remains startup unknown.
nodes.rationale: These mechanisms must remain distinct. The evidence does not attribute all stalls to motor power or the algorithm; more optimizer updates do not inherently fix an already-latched zero baseline.

nodes.label: Frozen evaluation integrity and execution audit
nodes.summary: Before retention, all 789 evaluation manifest files matched. Audited 3,648 native 100D/1D rows, reward sums and no-truth guidance; every TD3 action reproduced deterministic checkpoint inference. Policy tensors/counters stayed unchanged after every rollout. In 23 valid task epochs, maximum drive-source gap was 25 ms and control dt 7 ms; slot 16 had no valid task epoch. Ten software gate tests were not Gazebo runs.
nodes.rationale: Evaluation is a new experiment with per-rollout QC; it neither mutates the source models/replay nor converts the old failed training job into a pass.

nodes.label: Keep B0 reference; defer additional long training
nodes.status: Pilot decision; no policy promotion or additional long-training budget
nodes.summary: Prioritize goal-stop/odometry specification and startup wheel/clock diagnosis, then bounded B0/reference ablation. A suitable fixed classical speed/ramp control would be needed before claiming a residual time benefit; that ablation was not performed.
nodes.rationale: Even success in the missing learned-policy slot cannot exceed B0's five passes in this allocated pilot. This is not proof that TD3 is universally worse, and the small pilot does not justify extending training automatically.
